name: BFUSD
collateral: Binance-managed collateral pool and reserve fund, with hedged crypto positions and issuer-controlled risk buffers supporting the account balance product
pegMechanism: Binance account asset designed to hold a $1 reference value; eligible Binance users can subscribe and redeem within Binance rather than through an on-chain token contract

reserves.name: Binance collateral pool and reserve fund

notices.title: Off-chain account asset
notices.message: BFUSD is modeled from third-party market data and Binance documentation; no on-chain supply contract is configured.
